stem: Why do paragraphs 23 and 24 mark a turning point in the story?

options.label: F
options.text: Charlie Joe’s parents want to get his opinion about going to summer camp.

options.label: G
options.text: Charlie Joe understands that he should have worked harder in class.

options.label: H
options.text: Charlie Joe’s parents decide that the summer camp sounds like a good idea.

options.label: J
